finding.title: Reject unknown account types
finding.body: An account_type of 'typo' selects individual login instead of rejecting the unsupported account type. Validate the input enum first.

return enterprise ? enterpriseLogin() : individualLogin();

finding.body: Success returns payload under result while validation errors use data. Use the same envelope for this endpoint; a specific consumer failure is not established.
